'''Markus Christoph Blocher'''<ref>{{Cite web |title=Dr. Markus Blocher in Wollerau - Reports |url=http://www.moneyhouse.ch/en/person/blocher-markus-147142339401 |access-date=2023-03-17 |website=Moneyhouse |language=en}}</ref> (born April 16, 1971) is a Swiss businessman and billionaire. He is among the richest people of Switzerland, with an estimated net worth of $4 billion by ''[[Forbes]]''.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Markus Blocher |url=https://www.forbes.com/profile/markus-blocher/ |access-date=2023-03-17 |website=Forbes |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Bezos, Blocher und Co.: die spannendsten Miliardäre der Forbes-Liste |url=https://www.schweizer-illustrierte.ch/people/swiss-stars/bezos-und-blocher-hier-liegen-die-milliarden |access-date=2023-03-18 |website=Schweizer Illustrierte |language=de-CH}}</ref> Blocher holds a controlling stake in [[Ems-Chemie|EMS-Chemie]] and [[Dottikon ES]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Markus Blocher, Dottikon ES Holding AG: Profile and Biography |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/profile/person/6131291 |access-date=2023-03-17 |website=Bloomberg.com |language=en}}</ref> He is the son of former Federal Councilor [[Christoph Blocher]] and the younger brother of National Councilor [[Magdalena Martullo-Blocher]].

== Early life and education ==
Blocher was born April 16, 1971, in [[Zürich]], Switzerland to [[Christoph Blocher|Christoph]] and Silvia (née Kaiser) Blocher. His [[Godparent|godmother]] is Rosmarie Ebner, the wife of the Swiss financier [[Martin Ebner]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Mann des Monats Martin Ebner: Die Auferstehung |url=https://www.handelszeitung.ch/unternehmen/mann-des-monats-martin-ebner-die-auferstehung |access-date=2023-03-18 |website=Handelszeitung |language=de-CH}}</ref> His elder sister is now the CEO of [[Ems-Chemie|EMS-Chemie]] and a member of the [[National Council (Switzerland)|National Council]] for the [[Swiss People's Party]]. He primarily grew up in [[Feldmeilen]] on [[Lake Zurich]]. He completed a student exchange in the United States<ref>{{Cite web |title=Markus Blocher: "For innovation and creativity to thrive, people with experience and knowledge need to come together in person and work with one another." |url=https://www.alumni.ethz.ch/en/news/2021/08/markus-blocher.html |access-date=2023-03-18 |website=www.alumni.ethz.ch |date=25 August 2021 |language=en}}</ref> and had the desire to join the [[United States Army]] in his teens.<ref>{{Citation |title=Konkret - Silvia und Christoph Blocher im Exklusivinterview (Teil 1) |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c6i1lXwPsLM |access-date=2023-03-17 |language=en}}</ref> In 2000, he completed his doctorate at the [[ETH Zurich|Swiss Federal Institute of Technology (ETH)]].

== Career ==
After graduation he worked for three years as a consultant for [[McKinsey & Company]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Morrell |first=Alex |title=Swiss Chemical Conglomerate Mints Three Billionaire Sisters |url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/alexmorrell/2013/12/13/swiss-chemical-conglomerate-mints-three-billionaire-sisters/ |access-date=2023-03-17 |website=Forbes |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Die Blochers: Eine Familie regiert die Schweiz |url=https://www.handelsblatt.com/unternehmen/management/die-blochers-eine-familie-regiert-die-schweiz/2614198.html |access-date=2023-03-17 |website=www.handelsblatt.com |language=de}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |last=(Bilder) |first=Dominik Feldges, Dottikon, Annick Ramp |title=Dottikon ES: Markus Blocher hat seinen eigenen Weg gefunden |language=de-CH |work=Neue Zürcher Zeitung |url=https://www.nzz.ch/wirtschaft/dottikon-es-markus-blocher-hat-seinen-eigenen-weg-gefunden-ld.1562948?reduced=true |access-date=2023-03-17}}</ref> Since 2002, he worked as Vice President of Special Projects at [[Ems-Chemie|EMS-Chemie]] in [[Domat/Ems]]. In 2003, he was appointed managing director of Dottikon ES, which at that time still was part of EMS Group. Blocher was responsible for listing the company at the stock exchange in 2005. In November of the same year he exchanged his controlling shares of EMS with his sisters of Dottikon, and became majority owner.<ref>{{Cite web |last=AG |first=VADIAN NET |title=Markus Blocher übernimmt Mehrheit an Dottikon ES |url=https://www.wirtschaft.ch/Markus+Blocher+uebernimmt+Mehrheit+an+Dottikon+ES/227160/detail.htm |access-date=2023-03-17 |website=www.wirtschaft.ch |language=de}}</ref> Until this day he acts as CEO and chairman of the board.<ref>{{Cite web |last=MarketScreener |title=Markus Blocher - Biography |url=https://www.marketscreener.com/business-leaders/Markus-Blocher-13990/biography/ |access-date=2023-03-17 |website=www.marketscreener.com |language=en}}</ref> In 2020, he was awarded the title 'Swiss CEO of the year' in the Obermatt ranking.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Markus Blocher ist "Schweizer Firmenchef des Jahres" |url=https://www.cash.ch/news/politik/markus-blocher-ist-schweizer-firmenchef-des-jahres-439690 |access-date=2023-03-17 |website=cash.ch |language=de-CH}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
He is married and has seven children. Blocher resides in [[Wollerau]].<ref>{{Citation |title=10 vor 10 - Markus Blocher – Sieben Kinder und eine Firma - Play SRF |url=https://www.srf.ch/play/tv/10-vor-10/video/markus-blocher---sieben-kinder-und-eine-firma?urn=urn:srf:video:ef14cc0b-d663-4869-83ac-426a2f8be927 |access-date=2023-03-17 |language=de}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2015-08-10 |title=Elfter Enkel für Christoph Blocher: Siebtes Kind für Blocher junior |url=https://www.blick.ch/politik/elfter-enkel-fuer-christoph-blocher-siebtes-kind-fuer-blocher-junior-id4058253.html |access-date=2023-03-17 |website=Blick |language=de-CH}}</ref>
